description: A wallet's Aave transaction history (supply, borrow, repay, withdraw, collateral changes) on v3, v4, or both. Most recent first. v4 covers every chain; v3 reads one market on one chain at a time, because upstream paginates per market, so it states its scope as 'chainsCovered' and 'market' and you pass chainId to read another. Use get_user_positions, not this, to find out where a wallet holds anything.

chainId.description: Chain id to restrict to, e.g. 1 for Ethereum. Omit the argument entirely to cover every chain.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: copy 'pageInfo.next' from a previous call verbatim. It is opaque and cannot be edited, shortened or rebuilt - a value that was changed comes back as a base64 parse failure. Requires an explicit version ('v3' or 'v4'): a cursor belongs to one version's feed.

market.description: v3 only, optional: market pool address (defaults to the chain's main market).

name: get_user_activity
title: Get user activity / transaction history
